class="content-panel astro-7nkwcw3z"> <div class="sl-container astro-7nkwcw3z"> <h1 id="_top" class="astro-j6tvhyss">Reviewing code changes</h1>  </div> </div>  <div class="content-panel astro-7nkwcw3z"> <div class="sl-container astro-7nkwcw3z"> <div class="sl-markdown-content"> <p>Once you approve a plan, Jules begins working inside a virtual machine. As it completes steps, you’ll see an activity log with Jules’ thoughts and code updates. This page walks you through what to look for and how to respond.</p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="activity-feed">Activity feed</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#activity-feed"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="currentcolor" d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42Zm8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33ZM8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 1.1.22 1 1 0 0 0 .32-.22l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42Z"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only">Section titled “Activity feed”</span></a></div>
<p>As Jules works, you’ll see a real-time <strong>activity feed</strong> that logs:</p>
<ul>
<li>Each step it completes</li>
<li>Descriptions of what it did</li>
<li>Any outputs or errors encountered</li>
<li>Requests for additional information or feedback</li>
</ul>
<p>This feed gives you insight into Jules’ decision-making and progress.</p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="code-diffs">Code diffs</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#code-diffs"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="currentcolor" d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42Zm8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33ZM8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 1.1.22 1 1 0 0 0 .32-.22l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42Z"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only">Section titled “Code diffs”</span></a></div>
<p>When Jules changes code, you’ll see a <strong>mini diff</strong> directly in the feed. For a more complete view:</p>
<ul>
<li>On the right pane, you can view a full screen expanded <strong>diff editor</strong> to see all changes across files</li>
<li>The <strong>diff editor</strong> only shows files where it modified or added code.</li>
<li>Expand the diff editor to full screen, or drag the left sidebar of the diff editor to slide it to your preferred width</li>
</ul>
<p>You can download and copy code that Jules has written from the download and copy icons located in the top right of the diff editor panel. When you copy code, only the updated code will save to your clip board (not the full diff).</p>
<p>This is your central hub for understanding the scope of the changes Jules made to your repo.</p>
<p><img src="/docs/_astro/feedback.8l67aYbh_24Fkj7.webp" alt="Screenshot of feedback view" loading="lazy" decoding="async" fetchpriority="auto" width="3206" height="2610"></p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="interactive-feedback">Interactive feedback</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#interactive-feedback"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="currentcolor" d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42Zm8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33ZM8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 1.1.22 1 1 0 0 0 .32-.22l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42Z"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only">Section titled “Interactive feedback”</span></a></div>
<p>You can interact with Jules in real-time through the chat box:</p>
<ul>
<li>Ask it to revise logic or naming</li>
<li>Request additional tests or cleanup</li>
<li>Give corrections like “return an empty string instead of None”</li>
</ul>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="task-summary">Task summary</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#task-summary"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="currentcolor" d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42Zm8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33ZM8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 1.1.22 1 1 0 0 0 .32-.22l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42Z"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only">Section titled “Task summary”</span></a></div>
<p>When the task completes, Jules provides a final summary which includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ <strong>Files changed</strong></li>
<li>⏱ <strong>Total runtime</strong></li>
<li>➕ <strong>Lines of code added/changed</strong></li>
<li>🌿 <strong>Branch name</strong> and <strong>commit message</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="/docs/_astro/done.TcJfaelI_1Y9nlX.webp" alt="Screenshot of summary" loading="lazy" decoding="async" fetchpriority="auto" width="2016" height="940"></p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="pushing-to-github">Pushing to GitHub</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#pushing-to-github"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path fill="currentcolor" d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42Zm8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33ZM8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 1.1.22 1 1 0 0 0 .32-.22l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42Z"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only">Section titled “Pushing to GitHub”</span></a></div>
<p>Click <strong>Publish branch</strong> or <strong>Publish PR</strong> to push Jules’ changes to GitHub:</p>
<ul>
<li>Jules will appear as a commit author on the branch, if you manually create a PR from the branch, you will be the PR author</li>
<li>When publishing a PR, Jules will appear as the creator of the PR</li>
</ul>
<p>Once a branch is published, you can continue editing the branch, review it as a GitHub PR, or delete it.</p>
<p>Once a PR is created, you can send it for review, or merge the PR into your codebase.</p> </div> <footer class="sl-flex astro-3yyafb3n"> <div class="meta sl-flex astro-3yyafb3n">   </div> <div class="pagination-links print:hidden astro-u2l5gyhi" dir="ltr"> <a href="/docs/review-plan/" rel="prev" class="astro-u2l5gyhi"> <svg aria-hidden="true" class="astro-u2l5gyhi astro-c6vsoqas" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" style="--sl-icon-size: 1.5rem;"><path d="M17 11H9.41l3.3-3.29a1.004 1.004 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-5 5a1 1 0 0 0-.21.33 1 1 0 0 0 0 .76 1 1 0 0 0 .21.33l5 5a1.002 1.002 0 0 0 1.639-.325 1 1 0 0 0-.219-1.095L9.41 13H17a1 1 0 0 0 0-2Z"/></svg> <span class="astro-u2l5gyhi"> Previous <br class="astro-u2l5gyhi"> <span class="link-title astro-u2l5gyhi">Planning</span> </span> </a> <a href="/docs/tasks-repos/" rel="next" class="astro-u2l5gyhi"> <svg aria-hidden="true" class="astro-u2l5gyhi astro-c6vsoqas" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" style="--sl-icon-size: 1.5rem;"><path d="M17.92 11.62a1.001 1.001 0 0 0-.21-.33l-5-5a1.003 1.003 0 1 0-1.42 1.42l3.3 3.29H7a1 1 0 0 0 0 2h7.59l-3.3 3.29a1.002 1.002 0 0 0 .325 1.639 1 1 0 0 0 1.095-.219l5-5a1 1 0 0 0 .21-.33 1 1 0 0 0 0-.76Z"/></svg> <span class="astro-u2l5gyhi"> Next <br class="astro-u2l5gyhi"> <span class="link-title astro-u2l5gyhi">Managing tasks and repos</span> </span> </a> </div>   </footer>  </div> </div>   </main> </div> </div>  </div> </div>  </body></html>
